perspective:
Angela’s available information:

- She knows she is Angela Hwang, a hairdresser, and that she and Kevin Flores have been friends since high school; they confide in each other about personal and work lives. She knows Kevin works in construction.
- At coffee, she noticed/worried Kevin seemed unhappy with his job. Kevin told her he was “alright, usual grind,” then admitted he was not happy, felt stuck and unfulfilled, and was going through the motions. She suggested a different job/career; he said he had thought about it but felt unsure where to start and overwhelmed. She offered to explore options together; he agreed and thanked her.
- Afterward, she believed Kevin was considering a career change and felt supportive/hopeful. She found job openings and a career counseling service and told him. He thanked her. He told her he was interested in something creative, maybe design or architecture. She encouraged him to check the resources, saying she thought he’d be great. He said he would and that her support meant a lot.
- Later, she believed Kevin was hesitant and felt frustrated/worried. She arranged a meeting with a career coach. She told him she believed in him and that the coach could help. Kevin said he appreciated it but wasn’t sure he was ready; she encouraged a push/plan/confidence. He agreed to try it and thanked her.
- She believed Kevin was making progress, felt proud/relieved, and checked in. Kevin told her the coach was helpful, he had started online design courses, and he felt more confident. She offered more help; he said her being there was enough and her support meant the world.
- She believed Kevin had successfully transitioned to a new career, felt happy/satisfied, and organized a small celebration party. She told him he deserved it. Kevin thanked her and said he couldn’t have done it without her. She said he did the hard work and invited him to enjoy the party.

She has no access to hidden events or Kevin’s private thoughts beyond what he said or what she inferred/believed.
